formulas.ascii: w_ij = (1 - (d_ij/h_i)^2)^2 for d_ij < h_i, else 0 (bisquare); h_i = 1.00001 x distance to the k-th nearest included tract (adaptive). beta_i = (Z_i' W_i Z_i)^-1 Z_i' W_i y with z_j = (1, x_j - x_i), so the intercept is the fit at tract i and S_ii = [(Z'WZ)^-1]_00. AICc = n ln(RSS/n) + n ln 2pi + n (n + tr S)/(n - 2 - tr S) is minimised over k by golden-section search. se_ik = sqrt(sigma2 [C C']_kk) with C = (Z'WZ)^-1 Z'W and sigma2 = RSS/(n - tr S); t_ik = beta_ik/se_ik. Singular tracts give NaN.
